info.title: WACS Transpiler (deprecated
info.description: DEPRECATED — superseded by WACS.Cli (command: `wacs`). Install with: dotnet tool install -g WACS.Cli. Original: ahead-of-time WebAssembly-to-.NET IL transpiler for WACS. Installs the `wasm-transpile` CLI tool. For programmatic use, reference WACS.Transpiler.Lib.

options.name: --input
options.description:
Required. Input .wasm file(s). Repeat or comma-separate to
transpile / interpret multiple modules. When more than one
is supplied, the ModuleLinker composes them — module name
for cross-module imports defaults to the file basename.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Required. Output .dll path. With multiple inputs, this is
the path for the LAST input; siblings land at
<basename>.dll alongside.

options.name: --engine
options.description:
(Default: transpiler) Execution engine: transpiler (compile
to .NET assembly, default) or interpreter (parse + run
in-process via the WACS interpreter, no .dll emitted).

options.name: --namespace
options.description: (Default: CompiledWasm) Root namespace for generated types.

options.name: --module
options.description: (Default: WasmModule) Name of the generated Module class.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print transpilation diagnostics and a summary.

options.name: --simd
options.description:
(Default: scalar) SIMD strategy: interpreter | scalar |
intrinsics.

options.name: --no-tail-calls
options.description:
Disable emission of the CIL `tail.` prefix for return_call*
ops.

options.name: --max-fn-size
options.description:
(Default: 0) Maximum function body size (in instructions)
to attempt transpilation. 0 = unlimited.

options.name: --data-storage
options.description:
(Default: compressed) Data segment storage: compressed |
raw | static.

options.name: --gc-checking
options.description:
(Default: ) Comma-separated TranspilerCapabilities flags
enabling additional GC type-check layers.

options.name: --emit-main
options.description:
Emit a Program.Main(string[]) inside the output assembly so
it runs as an executable host for the transpiled module.
v0.1 only supports modules with no imports.

options.name: --entry-point
options.description:
(Default: _start) When --emit-main is set, the WASM export
Main invokes. Scalar args only (i32/i64/f32/f64).

options.name: --main-class
options.description:
(Default: Program) When --emit-main is set, the name of the
emitted Program class.

options.name: --run
options.description:
After transpile, invoke in-process. With --emit-main, runs
the emitted Program.Main and forwards trailing positional
args. With --wasi, instead invokes the module's entry
export (default _start) with WASI bound — trailing args
become WASI argv.

options.name: --wasi
options.description:
Shortcut for `--bind <path-to-Wacs.WASIp1.dll>`. Binds WASI
preview1 imports before running. Trailing positional args
populate argv.

options.name: --bind
options.description:
Path(s) to assemblies containing IBindable host libraries.
The transpiler reflects each assembly, activates every
concrete IBindable type with a parameterless ctor, and
wires them into the runtime before transpilation. Repeat or
comma-separate for multiple assemblies. Works with any
library following the IBindable pattern (WASI, custom game
hosts, etc.).

options.name: --host-package
options.description:
Path(s) or assembly name(s) of host packages whose
[WitSource]-tagged interfaces resolve a component's
WASI/host imports at transpile time. Each guest call
$import lowers to inline IL (typed callvirt) instead of
routing through a runtime delegate table. Repeat or
comma-separate for multiple packages. Component-mode only.

options.name: --wasip2
options.description:
Shorthand for `--host-package Wacs.WASI.Preview2`. Resolves
a component's WASI Preview 2 imports against the typed
interfaces shipped by the WACS host package. Component-mode
only.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

arguments.name: args
arguments.description:
Positional arguments forwarded to Program.Main when --run
is set.
